"Rapstar" is a song by American rapper Polo G.
It was released through Columbia Records as the third single from his third studio album, Hall of Fame, on April 9, 2021.
The song was produced by Synco, with social media star Einer Bankz performing the ukulele.
Hall of Fame is the third studio album by American rapper Polo G.
The album features guest appearances from the Kid Laroi, Lil Durk, Lil Wayne, Scorey, G Herbo, Rod Wave, DaBaby, Young Thug, Roddy Ricch, Nicki Minaj, the late Pop Smoke, and Fivio Foreign.
Production was handled by Einer Bankz, Angelo Ferraro, D Mac, Karltin Bankz, Londn Blue, BKH, Synco, Tahj Money, Varohl, & WizardMCE, among others.
